title: Pennsylvania says an unvaccinated woman has died from measles-related complications
content: Pennsylvania has announced its third measles-related death in less than three weeks. A local coroner says the 40-year-old woman was unvaccinated.

title: Trump downplays calls for AI slowdown
content: President Trump said there were "negative forces" predicting things that he says won't happen.

title: Can Gulf states and Iran negotiate the Strait of Hormuz without the U.S.?
content: Dania Thafer of the Gulf International Forum weighs in on previously scheduled talks between Iran and Gulf states. Shortly before this interview aired, Oman announced that the talks were postponed.

title: Wisconsin congressman survives emergency plane landing, swims to safety
content: Wisconsin Congressman Tom Tiffany escaped a sinking plane and swam to shallow water after an emergency landing in a lake. Tiffany and the pilot called 911 from on top of the plane.

title: Actor Tatyana Ali is advocating for Black and Indigenous maternal health
content: Actor Tatyana Ali says her healing journey after a traumatic childbirth has inspired her advocacy for Black maternal health, including support for midwives, doulas and other birth workers.

title: Politics chat: Trump's $5,000 promise to voters, Vance invokes Charlie Kirk
content: Following the midterm convention in Dallas, President Trump's $5,000 campaign promise has generated attention, but not belief. And, Vice President JD Vance characterizes Democrats as extremists.

title: From fracking to data centers: Hearing from people on both sides of the opposition
content: NPR's Ayesha Rascoe speaks with environmentalist, Bill McKibben, and public relations specialist, Frank Maisano, about opposition to industrial development projects like fracking and data centers.

title: Can you imagine a universe without a new 'Star Trek' on the horizon?
content: As Star Trek celebrates its 60th birthday, the long-running franchise is also grappling with the challenges of timing and technology. "Its audience is aging," says Strange New Worlds star Anson Mount.

title: Indonesian passenger ship overturns, sparking search for at least 129 missing
content: Indonesian rescuers said about 130 passengers and crew are missing after a ferry carrying more than 240 people sank in bad weather in the Java Sea on Sunday.

title: How a young woman was recruited to ISIS — and how she eventually escaped
content: A young Canadian mother shares her memories of being an ISIS bride, and her harrowing escape from the extremist group.
